review_history: Retained original independent source review: coordination scene-program/review-scene62-initial.md; whole integration candidate requires new independent review.
scope: Exact canonical query transport for Director38; no placement, native-import adapter, temporal constraints, generated environments or full Scene62 acceptance claim.
tests: Query regressions selected from original test_rig_scene3d_spatial.py; original sweep tests byte-identical; new cumulative shared-query-budget regression.

semantics.mesh_input: node-local vertices and integer topology mapped to matching SceneGraph node IDs; world transform applies once
semantics.surface_overlap: actual triangle separating-axis tests, touching counts; supports open source surfaces
semantics.solid_overlap: oriented closed edge inventory and signed-solid-angle containment of components; rejects open geometry
semantics.clearance: Positive clearance exists only for conservative AABB overlap; no exact positive triangle-distance guarantee
semantics.query_budget: One _QueryBudget can be shared across mesh_overlap calls using _budget; reject when cumulative operation exceeds the limit
semantics.bounds_only: Never treated as actual triangles; consumer must verify actual collider inventory before claiming collision-free state
semantics.sphere_sweep: Unsupported nested/cavity or interior-overlapping closed components explicitly reject; this limit does not replace separate solid mesh_overlap containment.
